prompt: What official document is prepared by law enforcement officers investigating a crash scene in Texas?

options.text: Texas Department of Insurance Automobile Loss Settlement Certification Form 104
Municipal Justice Court Formal Criminal Misdemeanor Indictment Affidavit Form 22
A handwritten official carbon-copy receipt issued by local county roadside towers
Texas Peace Officer's Crash Report (Form CR-3), transmitted directly to TxDOT CRIS
